fields.description: Issue includes extensive coverage of Miami Beach municipal politics and the upcoming Beach election, including discussion of mayoral and city council candidates and campaign issues. Also features racing coverage and handicapping commentary tied to the opening of Tropical Park and the Florida racing season, along with nightlife and entertainment items, local columns (e.g., "They Tell Me" and "Notebook"), and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach businesses and venues.
